packagePresets.label: Automation
packagePresets.description: CLI, HTTP, and workflow helpers for file automation and task glue.

packagePresets.label: Data Tools
packagePresets.description: General parsing and tabular processing helpers for explorer-adjacent scripts.

packagePresets.label: ML Core
packagePresets.description: CPU-friendly baseline for NumPy, ONNX, ONNX Runtime, and Torch workflows.

packagePresets.label: CUDA AI Indexing
packagePresets.description: Torch CUDA, GPU ONNX Runtime, and embedding/indexing helpers for local AI search and inference.

actions.label: Runtime Summary
actions.description: Returns Python/runtime metadata plus the registered action list.

actions.label: ML Probe
actions.description: Checks ONNX, ONNX Runtime, Torch, and CUDA availability inside the sidecar.

actions.label: CUDA Acceleration Probe
actions.description: Returns structured CUDA, Torch, ONNX Runtime, and AI-package readiness for the acceleration pipeline.

actions.label: Model Catalog Status
actions.description: Returns curated local-model install state, cache metadata, and registry-backed readiness information.

actions.label: Model Cache Summary
actions.description: Returns the managed local-model cache roots and total cache footprint.

actions.label: Prewarm Model
actions.description: Downloads and initializes a curated local model through the requested backend preference.

actions.label: Scan Directory
actions.description: Lists a directory with lightweight metadata from Python.

actions.label: Hash Paths
actions.description: Computes stable file hashes for one or more paths from Python.

actions.label: Build Semantic Index
actions.description: Indexes local text/code files into the Explorer semantic-search SQLite store.

actions.label: Query Semantic Index
actions.description: Runs a semantic query against an indexed Explorer root and returns file-ranked results.

actions.label: Find Similar File
actions.description: Finds semantically similar indexed files using stored file embeddings.

actions.label: Delete Semantic Index
actions.description: Deletes the semantic-search index rows for one Explorer root.

actions.label: Semantic Index Status
actions.description: Returns the stored semantic-search index metadata for one Explorer root.
